title: StepInput
description: Fiori numeric field with decrement/increment buttons, min/max clamping, precision and the SAP keyboard model.

usage.summary: Enter an exact number or adjust it by a predefined step.
useWhen: Let users enter a quantity precisely or increase and decrease it in predictable increments.
Support direct number entry as well as the step buttons and keyboard.
Set min, max, step and valuePrecision to match valid business quantities.

avoidWhen.when: Adjust a value approximately along a visual range, such as volume or brightness.
Enter a number without increment and decrement controls.
